info.name: RideShareEU API
info.description:
Every RideShareEU API endpoint. The Automated folder walks the full ride lifecycle (post, match, join, approve, chat, complete, rate, report), the admin console, and access control. Every request also asserts a response time under 2 seconds.

The login endpoint allows 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP and each run uses 4, so restart the API before a third run within 15 minutes.

item.name: 12. Reports
item.description: The seeded passenger has tripCount 0, so the report does not qualify for the ban ladder and the host keeps access.

exec: pm.test('the report is in the history', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().reports.length).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: Host is not banned by an unqualified reporter
13. Admin
item.description: Runs last. Uses the seeded admin account; every ban email goes to a reserved @test.local address, which the API never sends to.

exec: const r = pm.response.json().reports.find((x) => x.reportedUser && x.reportedUser.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('hostId'));
pm.test('the passenger’s report on the host is listed', () => pm.expect(r).to.exist);
pm.test('report dismissed without a ban', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'DISMISSED', banned: false }));
pm.test('suspended by an admin', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ error: 'ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED', byAdmin: true }));
pm.test('host is no longer an admin', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().isAdmin).to.eql(false));
